enableExtensionDesc: Allows browser extensions to communicate with the desktop application via local loopback.
extensionDisabledAlertDesc: The local HTTP loopback server is completely closed. No local network traffic is being listened to, ensuring maximum security for this environment.
extensionIdPlaceholder: Enter Chrome or Firefox Extension ID
pairingKeyDesc: This key has been copied to your clipboard. Paste this key into the Extension configuration.
pairingKeyMaskDesc: The key is masked by default. Click the eye icon to view or click copy to paste into your browser extensions.
minimizeToTrayLabel: Minimize to system tray on close
minimizeToTrayDesc: If disabled, closing the window will exit the program completely.
autostartDesc: Start Secure Vault Manager automatically in the system tray when you log into your computer.
extensionPairingDesc: The pairing key connects the Desktop app with browser extensions. This key remains constant unless you explicitly regenerate a new key.
chromeIdRequired: Please enter the Chrome Extension ID.
importDataDesc: Support 1Password export (.1pux), JSON, and CSV files.
exportDataDesc: Export vault items to JSON or CSV format.
unlockWithBiometricsDesc: Use Touch ID / Windows Hello or fingerprint to unlock. You will still need master password after restarting.
lockOnSleepLabel: Lock when computer locks or sleeps
lockOnSleepDesc: Lock when the system is put to sleep, screensaver starts, or user switching.
preventSleepDesc: Keep device active and prevent sleep while the app is active.
clearClipboardLabel: Remove copied information and passwords automatically
clearClipboardDesc: Clear passwords and one-time passwords from system clipboard after timeout.
alwaysShowPasswordsLabel: Always show passwords and full credit card numbers
alwaysShowPasswordsDesc: Display passwords and card details as plain text by default.
holdShortcutToRevealLabel: Hold Ctrl+Alt to toggle revealed fields
holdShortcutToRevealDesc: Temporarily reveal hidden fields while holding the Ctrl+Alt keyboard shortcut.
alwaysShowWifiQrDesc: Automatically display QR codes for Wi-Fi items.
lockOnCloseDesc: Automatically lock vault when the application window is minimized to the system tray.
changePasswordDesc: Change the password used to encrypt and unlock this vault.
passwordLengthError: Password must be at least 8 characters long
changePasswordError: Failed to change password. Please verify your current password.
